title: First Trip to Japan? 13-Page Guide for First-Time Visitors
desc: Planning your first trip to Japan? JAPAN LIKE A LOCAL is a 13-page PDF guide ($4.99) for first-time visitors. It covers money, cash and IC cards; trains and basic etiquette; tipping and everyday manners; convenience stores (konbini) and restaurants; useful Japanese phrases; common first-time mistakes; emergency information; a simple first-24-hours plan; and a one-page cheat sheet. Easy to keep on your phone while you travel. #japantravel #japantips #firsttimeinjapan
